summary: LEITE HOLDING AS (org. no. 996 200 485) is a private limited company (AS) based in Gloppen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2010-11-24. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 64.323 (Andre egeninvesteringsselskaper); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 1.3 m. CEO: Andreas Hetle; board chair: Andreas Hetle.
